name: beacon-mern
description: Convenience launcher for the MERN-layer (server + client) plus the existing Python pipeline they depend on.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n python,gateway,client -c blue,green,magenta "cd .. && uvicorn src.bms.api.app:app --reload" "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
